// Print character
float _char(sampler2D s, vec2 u, int id) {
    vec2 p = vec2(id%16, 15. - floor(float(id)/16.));
         p = (u + p) / 16.;
         u = step(abs(u-.5), vec2(.5));
    return texture(s, p).r * u.x * u.y;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord)
{
    vec2 uv = fragCoord / iResolution.xy;
    vec3 col = texture(iChannel0, uv).xxx*0.2 + vec3(0.2, 0.5, 0.6);
    
    const vec2 font_size = vec2(15.0, 9.0);
    vec2 uvF = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * font_size;
    uvF += vec2(-5.0, -font_size + 9.85);
    
    col *= vec3(1.0) - printStr1(uvF);
    uvF *= 1.25;
    uvF += vec2(-0.1, 2.7);
    
    col *= vec3(1.0) - printStr2(uvF);
    //col += vec3(0.6, 0.8, 1.0) * printStr2(uvF);

    fragColor = vec4(col, 1.0);
}
